summary: Reproduced the remaining hybrid-Mamba extra_buffer chunk-boundary failure on the prepared ROCm checkout: a prefix inserted during chunked prefill stayed unbacked when the final extend produced no new Mamba checkpoint. The fix makes finish-time component preparation fall back to the already committed cache_protected_len, causing the existing non-chunked insert walk to perform the deferred write-through without inserting or overwriting KV. Tests cover immediate write-through, selective threshold semantics, write-back compatibility, and the broader Mamba/unified-radix suites.

remaining_limitations: The reported 256K hybrid-KDA production model and its weights were unavailable, so that exact architecture/context length was not run.

No two-server MooncakeStore deployment was available; cross-instance storage reload was not measured. The regression instead verifies the same native HiCache backup state transition and controller path with real GPU pools.
Independent model-output numerical comparison is not applicable because the change only alters cache finalization bookkeeping and transfer scheduling; no kernel or model forward computation changed.
No native code changed, repository-environment.json declares native=null, and therefore no native rebuild was required or performed.

Current main already re-walks completed chunked prefixes for ordinary attention models. The verified remaining defect and fix are specific to hybrid-Mamba extra_buffer final chunks that create no new checkpoint. ReplaySSM/no_buffer behavior is unchanged.
